chart.title: Municipal water withdrawal
chart.subtitle: Total water withdrawal for municipal (domestic) purposes, measured in cubic metres (m³) per year. Municipal water is the annual quantity of water withdrawn primarily for the direct use by the population.
chart.citation: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations - AQUASTAT
